say:1:1311012001:1.text: Apologies, Callan is now more machine than man. He's forgotten himself and can only follow simple instructions. I hope he didn't hurt you all.
say:1:1311012001:1.source_cn: 实在抱歉，铐兰现在更像是个失去意识的机器，只能履行既定...

say:2:1311012002:1.text: Let me introduce myself. I am Carolina, and this is my brother, Callan. You must be friends of Valka. Welcome.
say:2:1311012002:1.source_cn: 我是卡列琳娜，他是我的哥哥铐兰。你们一定是瓦丽卡姐姐的...

choice_prompt:3:1311012002.text: Let me introduce myself. I am Carolina, and this is my brother, Callan. You must be friends of Valka. Welcome.
choice_prompt:3:1311012002.source_cn: 我是卡列琳娜，他是我的哥哥铐兰。你们一定是瓦丽卡姐姐的朋友吧。

say:4:1311012003:1.text: Welcome, Magister. I'm truly sorry for what happened earlier. What can I help you with?
say:4:1311012003:1.source_cn: 魔法师大人，请允许我再次向你们表示歉意。你们找我是为了……

say:6:1311012004:1.text: So, you need to enter Whiteridge Temple.
say:6:1311012004:1.source_cn: 你们要进入白山大教堂内部？

say:7:1311012005:1.text: Something may have happened there... I have an ominous feeling that danger is near.
say:7:1311012005:1.source_cn: 或许修道院里出事了……我感觉到那里很危险，非常危险。

say:9:1311012007:1.text: A miasma of madness and fear surrounds the place. For more than a month, this sense of dread has become stronger every day.
say:9:1311012007:1.source_cn: 修道院里有股疯狂和令人恐惧的气息，这一个多月以来，这种...

say:10:1311012008:1.text: Tell me, Carolina, are you still denied access to the temple by the acolytes?
say:10:1311012008:1.source_cn: 修道院的人还是不让你进入大教堂？

say:11:1311012009:1.text: Well, I am a Graveborn, after all. It's already kind of them to occasionally allow me to visit the cemetery and pay respects to my parents.
say:11:1311012009:1.source_cn: 嗯……毕竟我是亡灵，他们愿意让我偶尔去墓园附近瞻仰一下...

say:12:1311012010:1.text: But you have to go to the temple... Perhaps it's best if we report this to the central temple authority and wait for them to send someone.
say:12:1311012010:1.source_cn: 你们……你们最好也不要靠近大教堂。或许我们可以将这件事...

say:13:1311012011:1.text: But it'll be too late for those stuck in the time loop!
say:13:1311012011:1.source_cn: 可那样就太迟了，那些陷入时间循环的人会出事的！

say:14:1311012012:1.text: Carolina, we have to go. It's my duty...
say:14:1311012012:1.source_cn: 卡列琳娜，我们必须要去。这是我的……责任。

say:15:1311012013:1.text: Duty... Alright, I understand. I can take you to the secret passage that leads to the temple, but I can't go in with you. My duty now is to stay and protect my brother.
say:15:1311012013:1.source_cn: 责任吗……好吧，瓦丽卡姐姐。我可以带你们去通往大教堂的...

say:17:1311012014:1.text: Protect. Carolina. Do not. Leave. Do not. Let outsiders. Enter.
say:17:1311012014:1.source_cn: 保护，卡列琳娜，不出去。不允许，外人，进入。

say:18:1311012015:1.text: Fear not, Brother. I'll be back soon. Just wait for me here.
say:18:1311012015:1.source_cn: 别担心，哥哥，我很快就回来。你就在这里等着我，好吗？

say:21:1311012017:1.source_cn: 谢谢你，卡列琳娜……这样就够了。
